prompts.chuheun: Create an updated production Godot pixel-art ACTION sprite sheet using attached sheet as CHARACTER IDENTITY reference. Exactly SIX complete sprites, 3 columns x 2 rows. Landscape 1536x1024: exact 512x512 cells; every sprite AND its entire chain remains within its own cell with 28px empty margins on ALL sides. Transparent background, no grid/text/backdrop. High-detail crisp pixel art, realistic 7-head proportions, not chibi. Preserve uniform/face/color from reference. Every sprite is the same scale (human full height around 350px), feet baseline y=470 within EACH cell, hips near x=205 within EACH cell; consistency for animation. Character faces RIGHT in 3/4 side view. Every frame must contain ONE COMPLETE CHARACTER PLUS ONE PHYSICALLY CONTINUOUS SILVER CHAIN held tightly in the hand: no detached chains, no independent weapon, no loose fragments. Chain has clearly connected metal links, optional small cyan edge highlights but no giant magic trails. Frame order left-to-right top row then bottom: (1) chain twirl windup hand raised near right shoulder, chain circling behind and OVER head; (2) next twirl phase arm rotating forward, chain in broad loop out front at shoulder level; (3) next twirl phase elbow drawn back, chain sweeps LOW alongside body, torso twisting, connects naturally back to pose1; (4) attacking RELEASE, leaning forward and arm extending right, chain sweeps diagonally right from GRIPPED HAND; (5) IMPACT pose with deep forward lunge, forcefully outstretched hand and chain pulled nearly horizontal to far RIGHT, entire chain visible ending at x=475, body in left half of cell; (6) follow-through recovery pulling chain back in curved loop, knees returning upright. Clearly different poses, body weight and arms follow chain motion. NO swords, no separate weapon layer, no enemies. Do not copy reference grid poses; create these NEW six connected action poses. Character: Kang Chuheun, youthful man with short spiky black hair, white lapel, blue trim, gray waist sash, black uniform and boots, pale small ring chest badge.
